purpose: 把旧方案、旧实现、旧产物的失败事实与 CompanyBrain 对照、合同缺口和本轮修复绑定，不以结论或研究摘要代替证据

artifact_contract.promotion_rule: only passed current attempt may update promotion view; failures remain immutable

observation_schema.locator_rule: relative path plus line/JSON pointer/status field; host path only in host-only evidence
observation_schema.fact_rule: must state an observed file/code/runtime fact; conclusion-only prose is invalid
observation_schema.companybrain_comparison_rule: each blocking/major observation must pair the old result with the frozen CompanyBrain baseline for one quality case, projection and one of the five dimensions; comparison_status=not_comparable requires a concrete missing-evidence reason and blocks promotion

causal_mapping_schema.one_to_one_rule: every blocking/major observation has exactly one primary mapping, at least one comparison_evidence_ref, and at least one ordinary evidence ref; comparison evidence must point to the paired old-result and CompanyBrain atoms

source_scope.eligible_predicate: ordinary_present_eligible_count=87 and ordinary_present_total=87 and every eligible entry has a stable single-source Block/Claim closure
source_scope.route_release_effect: post-provider route verifier still requires 87/87 typed route closure; source-scope eligibility alone never creates a Reader or KD_WIN
source_scope.source_of_truth: current raw snapshot -> Source/Block/Claim ledger; route/page semantics are produced by Qwen and verified afterward
